question: How much of the short-budget development gain is available to the matched ordinary-depth arithmetic model with the same rationale supervision?
protocol: Train the existing seed-109 dense twin with exactly the original 128 ordered documents, complete response labels, 32 updates, AdamW and position cap of gsm-rationale-01. Compare against the archived K2 trained deployment on the same 32 frozen thinking turns at 256 tokens. Score K1 retention and update/generation time. Both parent lineages previously consumed 250211 targets. This pair attributes the combined training/deployment difference, not inference depth alone.
decision: Prefer K2 over matched K1 here only with >=2 net correct answers, at most 1.25x generation seconds, and retention NLL <= K1 + 0.03. No additional arm or training automatically follows. Preserve incomplete work on any warning or budget limit.
